title: Mazur's Separable Quotient Problem for Nonseparable Bourgain-Pisier $\mathscr{L}_\infty$-Spaces
summary: Mazur's separable quotient problem, open since 1932, asks whether every infinite-dimensional Banach space admits an infinite-dimensional separable quotient. We prove that any $\mathscr{L}_\infty$-space $Y$ containing a subspace $X$ such that $Y/X$ is infinite-dimensional with the Schur property admits $c_0$ as a quotient. The natural class to which this criterion applies is the nonseparable $\mathscr{L}_\infty$-spaces constructed via the Lopez-Abad extension method, the nonseparable analogue of the Bourgain--Delbaen spaces. For every space in this class, Mazur's problem is thereby resolved…
